TEMPEST MAN · ARENA FURNITURE 1 · WAVE 07, 12 MORE VARIANTS FROM YOUR PAINT-OVER (13 TO 24)

TWELVE MORE VARIANTS, ALL BUILT ON YOUR PAINT-OVER, NUMBERED ON FROM THE FIRST TWELVE SO THAT A NUMBER NAMES ONE PICTURE. EACH CHANGES ONE PART OF IT: THE APEX, THE FOAM (FOUR WAYS), THE THIN WATER (TWO), THE SHADOW (TWO), THE DEEP WATER (TWO) AND THE TOE. PICK ANY YOU WANT FOLDED INTO WAVE 07.

THE STARTING WAVE ITSELF, WITH NOTHING CHANGED, IS ON THE WAVE 07 BOARD. ALL PLAY 8 FRAMES OF 4 STEPS EACH, TWICE LIFE SIZE. THE SPEED BUTTON PLAYS THEM AT FULL, HALF OR QUARTER SPEED; STEP +1 PAUSES AND MOVES ON BY ONE STEP (1/60 S) EACH TAP. NOTHING HERE IS IN THE GAME YET.
